name: Terminal Green
tagline: A terminal session on GitHub-dark: JetBrains Mono only, green prompt and cursor, scan lines, diff panes and a tmux status bar. Adapted from the Terminal Green preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: GitHub-dark background and neutral steps; terminal green for prompts, cursor, keys and the one highlighted value; a darker green ramp for markers and secondary bars; red only for removed diff lines

typography.style: monospace only: headlines at 700/800 with tight tracking and markdown '#' markers, body at 400, italic comments as labels, code with syntax colors

best_for: Engineering talks for engineers: platform and CI reviews, postmortems, developer meetups, tooling demos and architecture walk-throughs. Strong for config diffs, command output, benchmarks and before/after numbers.
avoid_for: Non-technical audiences, sales and executive decks, brand or marketing launches, and anything that needs warmth or long prose. Monospace is wide and tiring in paragraphs.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
